name: RADIOTHERAPY_CONTACT_INFO
description: This table contains general contact specific information for external radiation therapy treatment records.

columns.name: RT_SUMMARY_ID
columns.description: The unique identifier (.1 item) for the radiotherapy summary record.

columns.name: CONTACT_DATE_REAL
columns.description: A unique contact date in decimal format. The integer portion of the number indicates the date of contact. The digits after the decimal distinguish different contacts on the same date and are unique for each contact on that date. For example, .00 is the first/only contact, .01 is the second contact, etc.

columns.name: CONTACT_DATE
columns.description: The date of this contact in calendar format.

columns.name: ERT_SUMMARY_CSN_ID
columns.description: The contact serial number (CSN) of the contact.

columns.name: CONTACT_NUM
columns.description: Stores contact number

columns.name: NAME_HX
columns.description: Stores the history of the record name

columns.name: CM_CT_OWNER_ID
columns.description: The Community ID (CID) of the instance that owns this contact. This is only populated if you use IntraConnect.

columns.name: RADIOTHERAPY_MODE_C_NAME
columns.description: Contains the mode of the contact, indicating if the contact represents the prescription, plan, or treatment summary.

columns.name: PARENT_RT_SUMMARY_ID
columns.description: Contains the parent record for the summary. For a phase, the parent ID will be a course. For a plan, the parent ID will be a phase.

columns.name: PARENT_RT_SUMMARY_DAT
columns.description: Contains the DAT of the parent ID at the time this record was created.

columns.name: ANTECEDENT_RT_SUMMARY_DAT
columns.description: Contains the DAT of the antecedent ID at the time this record was created.

columns.name: RADIOTHERAPY_STATUS_C_NAME
columns.description: Stores the status of the contact of the record.

columns.name: RT_STATUS_REASON_INTERNAL_ID_NAME
columns.description: The SmartData element name, such as "A Family History of Sickle Cell Anemia".

columns.name: TREATMENT_INTENT_INTERNAL_ID_NAME
columns.description: The SmartData element name, such as "A Family History of Sickle Cell Anemia".

columns.name: CHANGE_REASON_INTERNAL_ID_NAME
columns.description: The SmartData element name, such as "A Family History of Sickle Cell Anemia".

columns.name: REQUESTER_USER_ID
columns.description: Contains the EMP record of the requester of the plan or prescription.

columns.name: REQUESTER_USER_ID_NAME
columns.description: The name of the user record. This name may be hidden.

columns.name: REQUESTER_PROV_ID_PROV_NAME
columns.description: The name of the service provider. This item may be hidden in a public view of the CLARITY_SER table.

columns.name: REQUESTER_ROLE_PROV_ID_PROV_NAME
columns.description: The name of the service provider. This item may be hidden in a public view of the CLARITY_SER table.

columns.name: REQUESTER_DEPT_ID_EXTERNAL_NAME
columns.description: The external name of the department record. This is often used in patient correspondence such as reminder letters.

columns.name: REQUESTER_LOC_ID_LOC_NAME
columns.description: The name of the revenue location.

columns.name: REQUESTER_LAB_ID
columns.description: Contains the LLB record of the requester of the plan or prescription.

columns.name: REQUESTER_LAB_ID_LLB_NAME
columns.description: Interface laboratory name.

columns.name: REQUESTER_REGISTRY_ID
columns.description: Contains the HIP record of the requester of the plan or prescription.

columns.name: REQUESTER_REGISTRY_ID_REGISTRY_NAME
columns.description: The name of the In Basket registry in the HIP master file.

columns.name: REQUESTER_PAYOR_ID_PAYOR_NAME
columns.description: The name of the payor.

columns.name: START_DTTM
columns.description: Contains the expected start or actual start instant for a radiotherapy course, phase, or plan.

columns.name: END_DTTM
columns.description: Contains the expected end or actual end instant for a radiotherapy course, phase, or plan.

columns.name: CONTACT_LAST_UPD_VERSION_NUM
columns.description: Stores the FHIR version ID of the most recent version of the contact.

columns.name: INVOLVES_REIRRADIATION_YN
columns.description: Flag indicating if the course involves reirradiation of targets or organs at risk that were already irradiated in previous courses.

columns.name: NUMBER_OF_FRACTIONS
columns.description: Stores the number of  planned or delivered fractions in a phase or plan.

columns.name: NUMBER_OF_SESSIONS
columns.description: Stores the number of sessions in a course.

columns.name: ANTECEDENT_RT_SUMMARY_ID
columns.description: Contains the plan or prescription the summary is based on. For a treatment summary, this will reference a plan. For a planned treatment, this will reference a prescription.

columns.name: CONTACT_VERSION_INST_UTC_DTTM
columns.description: This item stores the last update instant of the contact, which is the instant the version in ERT 260 was created.

columns.name: TREATMENT_INTENT_TEXT
columns.description: This item stores the text element for the treatment intent that is to be used when the treatment intent code (I ERT 215) does not contain a coded concept.

columns.name: RT_STATUS_REASON_TEXT
columns.description: Stores a free text representation of the status reason when no coded value is stored in ERT item 210.
